_comment: Mouths marked on the bake's five head views (bake_maps.py faces, 512 px): [view, x0, y0, x1, y1]. Inside a box, texels matching the fish's tooth colour `rule` are teeth; make_shades.py paints them bone white on every skin and the Natural skin (owner, 2026-10-14: 'All fish should always have bone white teeth'). Rule `slot` is for teeth too small for those views (the Reef Shark's): bake_mouth.py renders close-ups of `mouth` (centre in the bake's body frame, radius, model units) to <maps>/<Fish>.mouth.npz and the teeth are the light bits inside the mouth's dark slot. The Nibbler and Puffer have no teeth.
